t: Sections 201, 202, and 203 of this title shall be effective upon the date of approval of this Act. The remaining provisions of this title shall be effective upon the termination of title III of this Act.

fable.w: This section only sets effective dates for provisions of a title. The phrase "date of approval of this Act" might superficially suggest an approval process, but it refers to enactment, not to any consultation with outside parties. No non-federal actor is involved in any federal decision here.
fable.s: Sections 201, 202, and 203 of this title shall be effective upon the date of approval of this Act.
